applicability: Cold E+PD serving with one GPU per effective stage instance
Four H800, Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, prepared vLLM 0.33.0 overlay, filesystem EC connector
720 single-image preprocessed MMMU validation requests, fixed 64 output tokens, zero embedding reuse
limitations: External author report. InferRSI campaign acceptance INCONCLUSIVE.
Published JSON and code hashes checked. Raw worker traces, image bytes, model weights and container were not independently replayed or verified.
Model weight revision absent. Overlay identity is partly represented by recorded script digests.
Two reverse-order rounds at one offered rate on one node. Central arrival window is about 12.5 seconds.
700 of 720 images resized into calibration range. Fixed-length completion does not evaluate MMMU answer accuracy.
First cold attempt failed on inconsistent media keys. Complete rerun uses corrected keys and explicitly forwards seed 9197.

findings.direction: Choose integer E:PD counts using independently estimated stage capacity
findings.reason: The minimum of E-pool and PD-pool capacity selected 2E:2PD. It ranked first in both cold four-H800 rounds, with 25.90 and 26.21 completed requests/s.
findings.revisit_when: Re-estimate stage rates and test alternatives when model, workload, hardware, transfer path or worker configuration changes.

findings.direction: Use actual visual work and paired queue observations to diagnose the limiting stage
findings.reason: Each wave encoded 720 images with zero EC and resident hits. One E completed about 23 requests/s with queueing, while two E workers kept up with arrivals and two PD workers completed about 26 requests/s.
findings.revisit_when: Align encoder, decoder and client counters to the same arrival interval before inferring bottlenecks.
